summary: The candidate talks about schools through the teacher who cannot afford to stay and the parent who knows their own child best, and says what the state or town must fund.
realLife: Candidates for governor, and a state minority leader, spoke of schools through teachers and parents. One said teachers cannot afford to live where they teach and that principals watch their best leave for pay elsewhere; one said parents ask about quality and teacher pay and not theory; one spoke as a father and said parents, not government, know their children. The asks were pay, funding and choice.
sources: Cary Kennedy, Colorado gubernatorial candidate, interview on her teacher-pay plan, Oct 2017 (Chalkbeat): https://www.chalkbeat.org/posts/co/2017/10/20/cary-kennedy-a-colorado-gubernatorial-candidate-wants-to-give-teachers-a-raise-heres-how/
